description:
Your Juris-M library contains 13 items, but 3 Supreme Court cases have duplicate entries with incomplete metadata (imported from conflicting sources). Your goal is to clean up the library.

1. Click on the 'Duplicate Items' collection in the left panel.
2. You will see 3 pairs of duplicates: 'Brown v. Board of Education', 'Miranda v. Arizona', and 'Gideon v. Wainwright'.
3. For each pair, select the version with the most complete information (full abstract, court name present) as the Master item.
4. Click 'Merge 2 Items' to merge them.
5. Repeat for all pairs until 'Duplicate Items' is empty.
6. Verify in 'My Library' that you have exactly 10 unique items remaining.
